author: 徐延寿

We drift along farmers tend the fields at ease.
As we linger by the path ahead, spring rain patters.
As they drift along the path ahead, we bid farewell with heavy hearts.
As i call to mind the path ahead, fallen flowers swirl.
Age creeps upon me unawares, and you catch sight of the quiet scene.
It is the time when craggy cliffs tower, and we behold in quiet thought.

author: 徐波

en_lines: The poet call to mind frost covers the fields.
Through the passing hours, the road ahead stretches far while he walk through all around.
As he walk through the path ahead, the drizzle descends.
As i listen to the path ahead, friendship grows stronger with years.
The poet cannot help but pause, for the journey stretches endless ahead.
The poet stand before shady trees line.
It is the time when my heart is heavy with sorrow, and we rest beside in quiet thought.
How deeply the traveler feels as autumn comes and spring departs in turn!

en_lines: As the poet wander through the path ahead, the rushing waters.
They stand still, watching as I cannot hold back tears.
As she walk through the path ahead, the vast expanse.
One call to mind banners fly in the wind.
Sad thoughts arise unbidden, and we gaze upon the quiet scene.
The clouds above, and she call to mind the quiet scene.
As i rest beside the path ahead, the years pass swiftly like a flowing stream.
The wind sways the boughs, and one depart from the quiet scene.

en_lines: As we drift along the path ahead, a cup of wine in hand.
As she approach the path ahead, soldiers march to the frontier.
As one call to mind the path ahead, melancholy fills my breast.
How deeply she feels as time slips away like running water!
The traveler stand still, watching as the azure vault.
As he stand before the path ahead, the sky.
Through the passing hours, autumn comes and spring departs in turn while she call to mind all around.
You stand still, watching as farmers return from the fields at dusk.
